title: Adding a note needs View permission on that kind of record
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A teammate at the same location to tag, User B, who can sign in: on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView"). They are listed under Settings -> Staff.
  3. A work order at this location: top menu Work Orders -> Create Work Order, select a customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), save.
  4. A part sale at this location: top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, pick the Customer and click Save.
  5. Create the test role: Settings (click your initials at the top right -> Settings) -> Roles & Permissions -> Create Custom Role -> in Choose a template pick "Service Advisor" -> Apply; untick Work orders -> View and leave Part sales -> View ticked; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST Part sales only" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> on User B's row click the edit icon -> in Edit Staff Member set Role to "ZZAUTOTEST Part sales only" -> Save & Close. User B must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  6. A second teammate, User C. On a QA branch only two users can sign in (Admin and Tech): when a step says "Sign in as User C", first give Tech ShopView User C's role (Settings -> Staff -> on Tech ShopView's row click the edit icon -> Role -> Save & Close; Tech signs out and back in) and run that step as Tech ShopView. For tagging or group membership only, any staff member (e.g. "Ashlee Thomas") can be User C. Create the test role: Settings (click your initials at the top right -> Settings) -> Roles & Permissions -> Create Custom Role -> in Choose a template pick "Service Advisor" -> Apply; leave Work orders -> View ticked and untick Part sales -> View; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST Work orders only" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> on User C's row click the edit icon -> in Edit Staff Member set Role to "ZZAUTOTEST Work orders only" -> Save & Close. User C must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as User B (Part sales -> View only). Try to open the work order and add a note to it or to one of its lines.
  2. Still as User B, open the part sale and add a note (New Note, type a message, save).
  3. Sign in as User C (Work orders -> View only). Add a note to the work order.
  4. Still as User C, try to open the part sale and add a note.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • User B cannot add a note to the work order or its lines.
  • User B can add a note to the part sale.
  • User C can add a note to the work order.
  • User C cannot add a note to the part sale: Work Orders -> View is not enough for a part sale.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Who can do what); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S10; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R3: “Adding a note to a work order or work order line requires 'Work Orders → View'.”
  • S10-R4: “Adding a note to a Part Sale requires 'Part Sales → View'.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
